description: WorldCereal classification is the project's Python software for producing cropland and crop-type maps from Earth-observation inputs. It supplies workflows using the Presto representation model, custom model training and openEO processing on the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. Users configure areas, periods, models and processing options; outputs are annual cropland or seasonal crop-classification products. Coverage depends on the selected imagery and processing region. Public source is free under MIT, but running the hosted processing workflows requires the relevant external account and computing allowance. A limitation is that cloud access, input availability and trained-model transferability affect practical reuse; a public code licence does not make all processing resources unlimited. The tools can prepare crop-area inputs for irrigation and food-supply simulations. They are distinct from the already catalogued 2021 WorldCereal crop and irrigation maps (data-esa-worldcereal-2021-global-crop-and-irrigation-maps-10m). The repository documents setup and processing and cites the 2023 WorldCereal paper. No account registration, imagery retrieval or cloud execution was attempted.
